adaptation_loop: later task-solving agent uses evolved harness
future_evaluation: Exp0 isolates harness-updating by varying the evolver with fixed solver anchors; Exp1 isolates harness-benefit by varying the solver with fixed evolver anchors, with an additional train/test split route.
vsm_interpretation: The benchmark directly exercises external/operational evidence -> adaptation option -> persistent capability change -> later operation. The adaptation organization is supplied by A-Evolve and must not be attributed to a task solver by association.

task_structure: 6 environments x 5 latent skill families x 6 tasks; T1-T3 acquisition, T4 context shift, T5 adversarial variant, T6 skill composition
adaptation_loop: Skill Author induces/revises persistent skill library
vsm_interpretation: Frozen deployment makes the persistent return-to-capability path explicit and separates durable procedural adaptation from current-episode repair and raw episodic reuse. The Skill Author is benchmark-hosted.

external_change: tools, reusable skills and specialist agents are introduced across multi-stage harness streams
adaptation_loop: observe experience under current harness version
carry memories/skills/prompts across subsequent harness versions
evaluate held-out performance under later harness stages
mode_boundary: Only self-evolving adaptation is classified direct. Deployment-only evaluation without persistent inner adaptation is a retention/robustness control, not direct S4.
vsm_interpretation: The self-evolving mode closes external harness change plus accumulated experience into persistent adaptation that affects later operation. No unrelated GitHub repository is attached by name similarity.

adaptation_loop: execute current harness on validation tasks
evolver diagnoses failures and edits persistent executable harness
validation-only feedback selects later harness state
selected harness is frozen and evolver sandbox destroyed
disjoint held-out evaluation measures future capability
future_evaluation: The evolver cannot access the 448-task evaluation suite during evolution; only the 160-task validation suite is available. Final evaluation occurs after the selected harness is frozen.
vsm_interpretation: The benchmark directly converts operating evidence into a persistent executable capability change and then measures later operation under a disjoint future evaluation surface. The S4 owner is the benchmark-defined evolver plus evolving harness organization, not the fixed policy model or a canonical Index harness.
